headline: Qualcomm Drops 8% on ByteDance ASIC Deal, Marvell Falls 10% as Custom-Silicon Stocks Slide
summary: Qualcomm shares fell about 8% to $201 and Marvell Technology dropped about 10% to $260 in Tuesday morning trading. The moves follow news of a ByteDance custom AI silicon deal touching Qualcomm.
why: Qualcomm is a major US chipmaker known for mobile processors and wireless chips. Marvell is a US designer of custom data center and networking chips, a segment where custom silicon competes with its products.

impacts.name: Qualcomm
impacts.why: Shares fell after news of a ByteDance custom AI silicon deal that touches Qualcomm directly.
